summary.zh-CN: 在已有 React 项目安装第一个组件，检查主题、依赖和键盘交互。
summary.en: Install your first component in an existing React project, then verify themes, dependencies and keyboard interaction.

title.zh-CN: 安装与主题 · 准备项目
title.en: Installation and theme · Prepare your project

summary.zh-CN: 准备 React、TypeScript 和 Tailwind CSS 项目。在消费项目初始化 shadcn；已经初始化则跳过。本仓库本身无需重新初始化。
summary.en: Prepare a React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS project. Initialize shadcn in the consumer project, or skip this if already initialized. Do not initialize this repository again.

title.zh-CN: 安装与主题 · 安装源码

summary.zh-CN: CLI 安装源码、依赖和主题。命令中的 Registry 地址由站点构建配置提供；公开部署必须设置 NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL。
summary.en: The CLI installs source, dependencies and theme. The build configuration supplies the Registry URL. Public deployments must set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.

title.zh-CN: 安装与主题 · 使用与检查
title.en: Installation and theme · Use and verify

summary.zh-CN: 运行项目后，使用 Tab 聚焦按钮、Enter 激活，并检查深浅主题。下面只是页面交互；生产保存逻辑由调用方提供。
summary.en: Run the project, focus the button with Tab, activate with Enter, and check both themes. This is a page interaction; callers supply production save logic.

title.zh-CN: 安装与主题 · 主题与作用域
title.en: Installation and theme · Theme and scope

summary.zh-CN: 默认主题使用共享语义 token。host 版本适配宿主变量；scoped 版本通过 ThemeBoundary 限制主题，并让 Portal 继承边界。
summary.en: The default theme uses shared semantic tokens. The host variant adapts host variables. The scoped variant limits the theme with ThemeBoundary, including portals.

title.zh-CN: 受控组件与调用方责任

summary.zh-CN: 分清显示状态、数据快照与真实执行结果，保留草稿并处理未知回执。
summary.en: Separate presentation state, data snapshots and execution outcomes. Preserve drafts and reconcile unknown receipts.

title.zh-CN: 受控组件与调用方责任 · 谁拥有数据
title.en: Controlled components and caller responsibilities · Data ownership

summary.zh-CN: 组件接收快照和回调，调用方负责请求、权限、持久化与执行。选中对象不等于启动操作；展开 ToolCall 不等于批准执行。
summary.en: Components receive snapshots and callbacks. Callers own requests, permissions, persistence and execution. Selecting an object does not start an operation, and expanding ToolCall does not approve it.

title.zh-CN: 受控组件与调用方责任 · 状态与恢复
title.en: Controlled components and caller responsibilities · States and recovery

summary.zh-CN: Interaction、Data 和 Runtime 是独立状态轴。刷新失败保留原数据；拒绝保留草稿；unknown 不显示成功，先按操作 ID 查询对账，再决定下一次写入。
summary.en: Interaction, Data and Runtime are independent axes. Preserve data on refresh failure and drafts on rejection. Unknown is not success: query by operation ID before another write.

title.zh-CN: 受控组件与调用方责任 · 版本与迟到响应
title.en: Controlled components and caller responsibilities · Versions and late responses

summary.zh-CN: Inspector 接收完整对象快照，调用方按对象 ID 丢弃迟到响应。Work Items 命令使用 queryKey、baseRevision 和 operationId，示例内存回执不替代服务端事务。
summary.en: Inspector receives a complete object snapshot; callers discard late responses by object ID. Work Items commands use queryKey, baseRevision and operationId. In-memory receipts do not provide server transactions.

summary.zh-CN: 组件默认中文，支持英文；切换显示语言不改变协议值、用户内容或草稿。
summary.en: Components default to Chinese and support English. Locale changes preserve protocol values, user content and drafts.

title.zh-CN: 国际化 · 安装与 Provider

summary.zh-CN: Registry 依赖带入便携 i18n。将 Provider 放在稳定的组件树位置，避免因语言变化重挂载编辑器。站点资源与便携组件资源相互独立。
summary.en: Registry dependencies include portable i18n. Keep the provider at a stable tree position so locale changes do not remount editors. Site messages remain separate from portable component messages.

title.zh-CN: 国际化 · 保留调用方内容

summary.zh-CN: 只翻译内置呈现文字。用户输入、终端输出、字段协议值和源码不自动翻译。切语言不触发服务写入。
summary.en: Translate built-in presentation text only. Preserve user input, terminal output, protocol values and source code. Locale changes must not trigger service writes.

summary.zh-CN: 理解安装 ID、依赖闭包与仓库源码的关系，选择适合宿主的主题。
summary.en: Understand install IDs, dependency closures and repository source, and choose a host-compatible theme.

title.zh-CN: Registry 与源码接入 · 使用真实安装 ID
title.en: Registry and source integration · Use the actual install ID

summary.zh-CN: 文档读取 Manifest 中的 registryId；它可能与组件名和文档 slug 不同。CLI 重写导入路径并安装依赖闭包，不应逐个猜测内部文件。
summary.en: Documentation uses registryId from the Manifest. It can differ from the component name or slug. The CLI rewrites imports and installs the dependency closure; do not guess internal file dependencies.

title.zh-CN: Registry 与源码接入 · 源码和示例的边界
title.en: Registry and source integration · Source and example boundaries

summary.zh-CN: 源码浏览器展示仓库原文件；安装结果含路径重写。示例文件可能包含 Provider、fixture 与失败注入。先理解示例适配层，再连接自己的数据服务。
summary.en: The source browser shows original repository files; installation rewrites paths. Example files can contain providers, fixtures and failure injection. Understand the example adapter before connecting your data service.

title.zh-CN: Registry 与源码接入 · 部署自己的 Registry
title.en: Registry and source integration · Publish your Registry

summary.zh-CN: 静态构建显式设置 NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL 为部署站点地址。公开构建不能依赖浏览器地址补救错误配置，也不能发布 localhost 安装命令。
summary.en: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to your deployment origin at build time. Public builds must not infer the Registry from the browser or publish localhost installation commands.

summary.zh-CN: 以已有的工作台组件为骨架，将导航、任务和对象详情放在合适的位置。
summary.en: Use existing workspace components to place navigation, tasks and object details in the right regions.

title.zh-CN: 组合工作台 · 从布局到任务
title.en: Compose a workspace · From layout to task

summary.zh-CN: WorkspaceShell 管理导航、主区、Inspector 和底部面板。工作项优先复用 WorkItemsWorkspace；画布复用 CanvasWorkspace。页面适配器持有 URL、fixture 或服务连接。
summary.en: WorkspaceShell organizes navigation, main content, Inspector and bottom panels. Reuse WorkItemsWorkspace for work items and CanvasWorkspace for graphs. Page adapters own URLs, fixtures and service connections.

title.zh-CN: 组合工作台 · 运行完整示例
title.en: Compose a workspace · Run a complete example

summary.zh-CN: 从示例库进入 Agent、Work Items 或 Canvas，检查窄屏、语言、状态恢复和键盘路径。本地演示只证明这些组件行为，不证明真实执行、存储或业务验收。
summary.en: Open Agent, Work Items or Canvas from the gallery. Check narrow layouts, locales, recovery and keyboard paths. Local demonstrations prove component behavior, not real execution, storage or business acceptance.

summary.zh-CN: 项目、执行、资源、交付与风险分析，附布局编辑和分析构建器。
